component.name: OCR Catalog
component.summary: Catalog and download OC ReMix songs and albums

description.p: OCR Catalog is a desktop app that lists publicly posted OverClocked ReMix songs and official OC ReMix albums, then downloads them from the same HTTP mirrors the website already publishes.
It is not affiliated with OverClocked ReMix. Please keep request rates polite. For a first-time full back-catalog, OC ReMix recommends their official BitTorrent collections.
